sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, pp.price AS price, ad.addOnProductId AS addOnProductId, ad.addOnName AS addOnName FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plp ON plp.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND plp.PortalId = po.PortalId AND pr.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plp.Precedence, pl.PriceListId) pp OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ao.PimProductId AS addOnProductId, ao.ProductName AS addOnName FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType) AND EXISTS (SELECT apr.SKU FROM dbo.ZnodePrice apr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList apl ON apl.PriceListId = apr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal aplp ON aplp.PriceListId = apl.PriceListId WHERE apr.SKU = ao.SKU AND aplp.PortalId = po.PortalId AND apr.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND (apl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (apr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apr.ExpirationDate >= @now)) GROUP BY ao.PimProductId, ao.ProductName, ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder, ao.PimProductId) ad WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) AND EXISTS (SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = c.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT a.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = c.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed)) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId) >= @minAddOns AND (@minAddOns = @none OR ad.addOnProductId IS NOT NULL) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable) >= @minPersonalizableAttributes AND (@personalizationAttribute IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT pa.PimAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable AND pa.AttributeCode = @personalizationAttribute)) AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.ZnodeProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @publishSuccess AND pe.IsActive = @storefrontActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @storefrontObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rq.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) <= @minAddOns AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @none ORDER BY p.SKU
